config.grain_rationale: One record is a single legal entity (identified by ABN) plus its reported corporate income tax figures for one income year. The entity is the subject; the tax amounts are annual figures about it, not separate facts to map.

record_id.rationale: ABN is present for 99.1% and has 431 distinct values across 435 rows, so it is not unique per record; a content_hash over the row is the traceable key.

fields.rationale: ATO tax transparency rows name the entity as registered for tax purposes; all sampled values carry corporate legal suffixes (PTY LTD / PTY LIMITED / LIMITED), supporting a registered legal name rather than a trading/brand name. There is no separate trading-name column.
Column is literally ABN; profile shows 100% checksum-valid 11-digit values (abn_checksum_valid_rate 1.0) across 431 present values.

constants.rationale: Australian Taxation Office register covering Australian entities; country evident from metadata, not stated per row.

unmapped.reason: Financial amount with no ontology target.

config.notes: Only the 'Income tax details' sheet is onboarded; 'PRRT details' is a separate 21-row petroleum resource rent tax sheet needing its own mapping. No publisher documentation supplied, so entity_type is left unmapped rather than inferred from name suffixes; no status or licence-style columns exist. Financial columns deliberately unmapped (ontology has no monetary targets). Income year spans 2022-23..2024-25 in discovery, so rows are not all from the advertised 2024-25 report.

fields.reason: Name column on ATO Corporate Tax Transparency rows carries the registered entity name; sampled values are all corporate legal forms (PTY LTD / PTY LIMITED), consistent with legal_name rather than a display/trading name. claim_scope current_legal_name is appropriate and no validity date is attached, which is correct since no registration-name date exists in the source.

Source column is literally ABN and the abn op applies checksum validation; held-out values (e.g. 94600082111, 19052489924, 83114980880, 19651498716, 16634403124, 33104201014, 80625934116) are all 11-digit and checksum-valid, so emitted entity.abn claims are well-formed and correctly typed.

Constant AU for address.country is supported by publisher metadata (Australian Taxation Office, Australian entities with ABNs); it is a country-level statement, not a fabricated street/premises address, so it does not overclaim.

missed.reason: Do NOT map this. Listed only to record that it was considered: '2024-25' is a tax reporting period label, not a registration date, so leaving it unmapped is correct rather than a genuine miss. No source column in this file plausibly supplies entity.date_registered, entity.entity_type, entity.status, entity.acn, entity.trading_name, entity.website or entity.industry_code, so no real unmapped target is missed.

critic.summary: All three rules are sound: legal_name comes from the registered-name column with no trading-name confusion and no misattached validity, ABN is checksum-validated against a literal ABN column and produces well-typed 11-digit values across the rare/unusual held-out rows, and the AU country constant is supported by publisher evidence without implying a premises address. The financial columns and the income-year period label have no ontology targets and are legitimately unmapped; no entity_type, status, or registration-date data exists in this source, so those ontology fields correctly remain unpopulated rather than guessed.
